title: Proposal: model/reasoning selectors and session restore for the ACP adapter
description: Follow-up to proposal.0001 (proposals/0001-acp-adapter-core.md, PR #1), which ships the core turn path only: no session config options and in-memory sessions. This proposal adds ACP session config options for model and thought level backed by OMP's model registry (only models and levels the engine actually offers), persistence of Pico sessions in a Pico-owned directory, and session/load with history replay without duplicate messages or tool results (brief PROTOTYPE.md criteria 6 and 10). It needs an ontology review of the Pico/ACP/OMP session identity mapping. Out of 0001's scope by Mark's decision on 2026-10-30.
